findings.title: Overflow owner property set lazily during layout
findings.message: SizeUp measures widths only when the frame lays out. In SizeDown, the check `len(f.widths) != len(f.owner.children)` silently falls back to non-overflow layout if children change. The overflow owner property is set only on the last child during SizeUp, so menuDescriptor on a freshly mounted More button may not see the owner before its first open. This leaves a race where menu options are unfiltered.
findings.suggestion: Set toolbarOverflowOwnerProperty at mount/sync time rather than during SizeUp, and ensure it is cleared on retire.
